name: India Lease Development Limited
about: India Lease Development Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in the hire purchase and leasing business in India. The company offers financial services for commercial vehicles, automobiles, construction, earth moving equipment, and machineries. It serves small road transport operators owning trucks; and small to medium contractors engaged in road construction, mining, earthmoving, and other allied activities. India Lease Development Limited was incorporated in 1984 is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
